title: Indian Ocean slave trade
place: East Africa, Southern Arabia, west coast of India and Indian Ocean islands
summary: Enslaved people, mainly from East Africa, were shipped around the Indian Ocean to Arabia, India and island plantations. One estimate puts about 8 million taken from East Africa between the 7th century and 1920.
why: Shows slavery and its trade routes ran across the Indian Ocean world too; Zanzibar only outlawed the trade under pressure in 1873.

notes.problem: The 8 million figure is one estimate (N'Diaye and Petre-Grenouilleau), not a consensus of historians.
